description: Delegate a bounded sub-task to a **minimal-brain worker** (cheap model, parallel). Worker has NO persona/memory/skills—YOU must supply everything in task+context. Parent plans and explores; worker only executes. Do NOT paste large data in task—save to file and pass path in context. Use native/relative paths for output_cwd. Returns sub-id immediately; use delegate_wait for results.

task.description: Executable brief: (1) goal (2) input paths/commands—no huge pasted data (3) output path+format+acceptance (4) scope/forbidden edits

context.description: Facts parent already knows: data file paths, schema/columns, decisions, format—so worker does not re-explore. Strongly recommended.

tools.description: Tool whitelist e.g. read_file, create_file, run_command

max_rounds.description: Max tool rounds (default config subagent.default_max_rounds, max 16)

wait.description: If true, block until this worker finishes
